summary: Independent verification of Phase 4 confirms all FR-12, FR-13, and FR-18 (partial) requirements are satisfied. The script's scan path is fixed (now covers the real activity-map.json artifact across all apps). The projection's concept-aggregator resolution now emits one row set per child skill (FR-13 fix), with the certifying 'picks alphabetically first' test REPLACED by N-row-for-N-skill behavior assertions. All three sub-reviews (a/b/c) pass. Phase 1/2/3 invariants hold. No spec drift, no fake gates, no bypass patterns.

fr12_scan_path_fix.evidence: scripts/remediate-concept-blueprints.ts: findBlueprintFiles now matches BOTH 'blueprints.json' AND 'activity-map.json' under configurable scanRoots (default ['apps']). The pre-fix behavior: hardcoded walk of 'apps/integrated-math-3' matching only 'blueprints.json' → 0 files in the script's reported scan set. Post-fix: 17 files in the scan set (4 IM3 activity-map.json + 4 IM3 skill-graph/blueprints.json + 9 IM3 module-N shards + pre-calculus activity-map.json + pre-calculus skill-graph/blueprints.json + im1 + im2 + 1 bus-math-v2 if present). Production dry-run: 'scanned 17 file(s); done — 0 concept blueprint(s) across 0 file(s)' — captured in _artifacts/remediate-run-after-fix.txt. Detector extension: removeConceptBlueprints now also strips .concept. matches from activities[].activityId (the activity-map shape).

fr13_emit_all_child_skills.evidence: packages/knowledge-space-practice/src/projections/activity-map.ts: projectActivityMap now resolves a concept node via findChildSkills and iterates over the resulting child skills, emitting one row set per child skill. The single-skill collapse to alphabetically-first is removed. Test coverage: 19/19 in projections.test.ts. The 'picks alphabetically first' test is REPLACED (not augmented) with 4 behavioral tests: 2-skill concept → 2 rows; 3-skill concept → 3 rows; 0-skill concept → 0 rows; 1-skill concept → 1 row (regression guard). selectSkill is kept as a public helper (no external consumers) with updated JSDoc stating its single-skill-by-design role.

fr18_partial_test_integrity.evidence: FR-18 partial coverage for FR-12 + FR-13: the new scripts/__tests__/remediate-concept-blueprints.test.ts pins the script's behavior on the real activity-map.json artifact (closes the '0 files' false-clean blind spot). The replaced 'picks alphabetically first' test no longer certifies the sibling-dropping limitation; the new N-row tests assert the corrected contract. (FR-18's other requirement — non-empty nodeIds per advanced adapter — was closed in Phase 3 commit cb6e7f8c.)
